skills.name: Art-Direction

skills.name: Audio-Design
skills.description: Design game audio systems including music, sound effects, ambient soundscapes, adaptive audio, and audio implementation strategy.

skills.name: Design-System-Governance

skills.name: Game-Balancing

skills.name: Game-Concept

skills.name: Game-Publishing

skills.name: Game-Testing

skills.name: Information-Architecture

skills.name: Interaction-Design

skills.name: Level-Design

skills.name: Mechanics-Design

skills.name: Mobile-Ui-Optimization

skills.name: Multiplayer-Design

skills.name: Narrative-Design

skills.name: Ux-Writing-Microcopy

skills.name: Visual-Design-Direction
